<translated_code>
#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class C {
    istream& reader;
    ostream& writer;
    std::stringstream tokens;
    bool eofFlag;

    static const string BAD_CHARS;
    static const string TARGET;
    static const int INF;

public:
    C() : reader(cin), writer(cout), eofFlag(false) {
        execute();
        // stressTest(); // Uncomment if needed
    }

    void execute() {
        getNextInt();
        string s = nextToken();
        writer << fast(s) << "\n";
    }

    string convert(const string& s) {
        string sb;
        for (char c : s) {
            if (BAD_CHARS.find(c) != string::npos) {
                sb.push_back(c);
            } else {
                sb.push_back('A');
            }
        }
        return sb;
    }

    int slowMethod(const string& s) {
        string s2 = convert(s);
        std::unordered_map<string, int> visited;
        std::queue<string> queue;
        queue.push(s2);
        visited[s2] = 0;

        while (true) {
            string current = queue.front();
            queue.pop();
            int dist = visited[current];
            if (current.find_first_of(BAD_CHARS) == string::npos) {
                return dist;
            }
            for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < current.size(); i++) {
                string swapped = swapChars(current, i, i + 1);
                if (!swapped.empty() && visited.find(swapped) == visited.end()) {
                    visited[swapped] = dist + 1;
                    queue.push(swapped);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    string swapChars(const string& s, int i, int j) {
        if (s[i] == s[j]) return "";
        string arr = s;
        std::swap(arr[i], arr[j]);
        return arr;
    }

    int fast(const string& s) {
        string s2 = convert(s);
        int n = (int)s2.size();
        vector<int> a(n);
        vector<vector<int>> pos(3);
        vector<int> sz(3, 0);

        vector<vector<vector<int>>> cntHere(3);
        for (int c = 0; c < 3; c++) {
            cntHere[c] = vector<vector<int>>(n, vector<int>(3, 0));
        }

        vector<vector<int>> pref(n + 1, vector<int>(3, 0));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = TARGET.find(s2[i]);
            int c = a[i];
            if (sz[c] >= (int)pos[c].size()) {
                pos[c].push_back(i);
            } else {
                pos[c][sz[c]] = i;
            }
            for (int c2 = 0; c2 < 3; c2++) {
                pref[i + 1][c2] = pref[i][c2];
            }
            pref[i + 1][c]++;
            sz[c]++;
        }

        int sz0 = sz[0], sz1 = sz[1], sz2 = sz[2];

        // Initialize 4D DP array
        std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>> dp(2,
            std::vector<std::vector<std::vector<int>>>(sz0 + 1,
                std::vector<std::vector<int>>(sz1 + 1,
                    std::vector<int>(sz2 + 1, INF))));

        int answer = INF;
        dp[0][0][0][0] = 0;

        for (int j0 = 0; j0 <= sz0; j0++) {
            for (int j1 = 0; j1 <= sz1; j1++) {
                for (int j2 = 0; j2 <= sz2; j2++) {
                    for (int last = 0; last < 2; last++) {
                        int totalIdx = j0 + j1 + j2;
                        int current = dp[last][j0][j1][j2];
                        if (current == INF) continue;
                        if (totalIdx == n) {
                            answer = std::min(answer, current);
                            continue;
                        }
                        if (j0 < sz0) {
                            int cost = std::max(j1 - pref[pos[0][j0]][1], 0)
                                + std::max(j2 - pref[pos[0][j0]][2], 0);
                            dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2] = std::min(dp[1][j0 + 1][j1][j2], current + cost);
                        }
                        if (j1 < sz1 && last == 0) {
                            int cost = std::max(j0 - pref[pos[1][j1]][0], 0)
                                + std::max(j2 - pref[pos[1][j1]][2], 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2] = std::min(dp[0][j0][j1 + 1][j2], current + cost);
                        }
                        if (j2 < sz2) {
                            int cost = std::max(j0 - pref[pos[2][j2]][0], 0)
                                + std::max(j1 - pref[pos[2][j2]][1], 0);
                            dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1] = std::min(dp[0][j0][j1][j2 + 1], current + cost);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return answer;
    }

    string generate() {
        static std::mt19937 rng(789);
        int n = 9;
        std::string buf(n, 'A');
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            buf[i] = TARGET[rng() % 3];
        }
        return buf;
    }

    void stressTest() {
        static std::mt19937 rng(789);
        for (int t = 0;; t++) {
            string s = generate();
            int fastRes = fast(s);
            int slowRes = slowMethod(s);
            if (fastRes != slowRes) {
                cerr << "Discrepancy on: " << s << "\n";
                cerr << "Fast: " << fastRes << "\n";
                cerr << "Slow: " << slowRes << "\n";
                throw std::runtime_error("Mismatch");
            }
            cerr << "Iteration: " << t << "\n";
        }
    }

    string nextToken() {
        while (!tokens || tokens.str().empty() || tokens.rdbuf()->in_avail() == 0) {
            std::string line;
            if (!getline(reader, line)) {
                eofFlag = true;
                return "";
            }
            tokens.str(line);
            tokens.clear();
        }
        std::string token;
        tokens >> token;
        return token;
    }

    int getNextInt() {
        string token = nextToken();
        return stoi(token);
    }
};

const string C::BAD_CHARS = "VK";
const string C::TARGET = "VKA";
const int C::INF = 1000000;

int main() {
    C c;
    return 0;
}
